bosc:provenance.subject: The Meta 'Bowling Green Data Center' / 'Project Accordion' land assembly, Middleton Township, Wood County OH (FIPS 39173) — TWELVE contiguous auditor parcels deeded to LIAMES, LLC, 775.020 ac deeded / 774.878 ac planar, plus three parcels that are NOT part of that holding and are kept apart by the `parcel_role` property: the A. Schaller Limited Partnership tract with a rezoning pending, the parcel of record for the Apollo behind-the-meter power plant's air permit, and the Oppidan colo site 4.83 mi away in the City of Bowling Green. #1436, sub-issue of #1433.

caveats: [verified] Owner of record, deeded acreage, land use, tax district, school district, conveyance date/instrument/price, deed and conveyance numbers, appraised land and improvement values, the CAUV land value and the legal description are verbatim from the Wood County Auditor's Vision CAMA on the county's own Vision_Parcels layer 0, read 2026-08-01; null means the service had no value. planar_acres is measured from the committed geometry in UTM 17N (EPSG:32617) and is NOT reconciled to the auditor's deeded acres — cite the deeded figures for the record and the planar ones for area/runoff modeling.

THE PROPERTY IS `parcel_role`, NOT `role`, AND THAT IS NOT COSMETIC. The exporter's campus_from_parcels() reserves `role`, `label`, `grantee` and `color` for its own display fields and DROPS a source property of any of those names on the way into the geo/campus feed. A discriminator called `role` here would vanish silently from the published feed, leaving fifteen parcels that all read as one campus.

THE ASSEMBLY IS ONE CONTIGUOUS BLOCK, AND THAT IS A MEASUREMENT. The union of the twelve Liames parcels is a SINGLE polygon of 774.878 ac against a sum of parts of 774.883 ac. The 0.004764-ac (about 19 m2) difference IS the total pairwise intersection, so they abut along shared boundaries that overlap by slivers at that scale: the claim is 'one contiguous block', never 'they do not overlap' — across a 1,821 m x 2,489 m extent. The register carried '~750-ac Liames assembly' as [reference] press; the land of record is 775.020 ac deeded and it is one block. The four tracts over 50 ac (753.65 ac) are themselves one contiguous polygon; the eight small parcels (21.37 ac) are the fringe along SR-25 (Dixie Hwy), Mercer Rd and Middleton Pike that closes it.

THE COUNTY TAX ROLL MAILS LIAMES' BILLS TO META'S HEADQUARTERS. Eight of the twelve parcels carry the owner mailing address '1 META WAY, MENLO PARK, CA 94025' (spelled 'MENLOW PARK' on four of them, verbatim as served); the other four go to a Columbus address the county spells two ways — '52 E GAY ST, COLUMBUS, OH 43215' on three and '52 EAST GAY ST, COLUMBUS, OH 43215' on 611190000036001. All four spellings are carried verbatim rather than normalized. Meta's operator role was already [verified] from its own 2025-04-09 announcement — this is an independent documentary corroboration in the tax record, not the source of the attribution. A billing address is not a certificate of ownership of the LLC; the Ohio SOS registration for Liames, LLC remains [open] (#1437 probed it; the SOS business search is automation-blocked).

THE SUM OF THE TRANSFER PRICES IS NOT WHAT THE LAND COST, AND MUST NEVER BE QUOTED AS IF IT WERE. The CAMA carries only the LAST conveyance per parcel. On 2025-04-09 eleven predecessor tracts were consolidated into the two large campus parcels by quitclaim to Liames itself at $0 (deed numbers 0519 and 0520, consecutive), which erased their purchase prices from this layer. What survives across the twelve rows sums to $6,921,460 — a FLOOR on a fraction of the assembly. The ~$9M reported for the 2023-09-05 warranty deeds (Toledo Legal News transfer listings, [reference]) is not visible here at all. Every conveyance number in this file is distinct, so the Clinton County 'consideration is per deed, repeated on every parcel' trap does NOT apply — but the deeds themselves, at the Recorder, are still the instrument. [open]

THE PARCEL FABRIC MOVED UNDER THIS SITE — DO NOT TRUST AN ID JOIN ACROSS LAYERS. 611190000003500 (322.5 ac) and 611190000029510 (196.5 ac) are 2025-04-09 consolidations. Their eleven predecessors — 611190000002500, 002501, 003000, 004000, 005000, 007000, 020000, 029500, 032000, 032002 — still populate the township zoning layer, which was built from an older CAMA extract, and sum to 319.99 ac and 195.86 ac respectively. township_zoning_2025_11_13 on each feature is therefore read by GEOMETRIC OVERLAP, never by parcel id, and names the old-fabric parcels it read through in zoning_fabric_parcels.

CAUV READS ZERO ON THE TWO CONSOLIDATED TRACTS AND THAT HAS TWO READINGS. The 160-ac and 74.65-ac parcels acquired 2023-11-14 still carry CAUV land values ($585,960 and $255,360); the 322.5-ac and 196.5-ac tracts consolidated 2025-04-09 read 0. SEVEN of the eight fringe parcels also read 0, but 611190000009000 (1.01 ac, 21630 Dixie) reads $46,750 — 'the fringe is off CAUV' is not a rule and the one exception belongs on the record. Either the campus core came off current agricultural use valuation, or the new parcel numbers have not been re-valued at this extract. The auditor's CAUV recoupment record settles it and is not in the corpus. [open] — do not report the zeros as a documented removal from CAUV. Note also that CAUV (R.C. 5713.30) is NOT the Agricultural District program (R.C. 929) whose 75.143 ac the Apollo OPSB staff report says will not be retained; different statutes, different registers.

ZONING, AND THE ONE THING NO PUBLISHED LAYER CARRIES. In the township's own parcel-joined layer, content built 2025-11-13: the four campus tracts read 99.8-100% 'M-1: Light Industrial' (the 2023 agricultural-to-industrial rezonings ARE carried), seven of the eight small parcels read 'A-1: Agricultural' and the eighth (611190000025000, 21186 Dixie) reads 'R-4: Multiple Dwelling'. Those eight are part of the thirteen parcels / 31.82 ac that Middleton Township trustees rezoned to M-1 on 2026-07-07 — so the layer is showing their PRE-rezoning districts. As of 2026-08-01 NO published Wood County layer carries that rezoning: the countywide township layer is a 2013 snapshot, and the hosted Middleton layer's zoning content is a 2025-11-13 build. TWO SOURCES BACK THAT AND THEY ARE NOT THE SAME EVIDENCE. The committed fixture covers the campus envelope only — 296 rows, all created 2025-11-13, newest edit stamp in it 2026-05-12 on parcel 611190000002501. The stronger claim, that the layer's only other 2026 edits countywide are three unrelated Hull Prairie parcels on 2026-07-14, comes from a full-layer paged probe of all 6,816 rows run 2026-08-01 that is NOT committed as a fixture; the service's own lastEditDate of 2026-07-14 is layer metadata, not a row. Re-run that probe before restating it. Either way this is a publication lag, not a finding about their zoning.

THE 2026-07-07 REZONING IS NOT FINAL, AND THE GEOMETRY IS COMMITTED WITH THAT STATUS. Wood County Planning Commission recommended it 6-2 on 2026-06-02; the Middleton Township Zoning Commission REJECTED it on 2026-06-10; the trustees granted it anyway 2-1 on 2026-07-07 (Moulton and Vetter in favor, Petrea against). Under R.C. 519.12 that starts a 30-day referendum-petition window closing about 2026-08-06, and a petition drive requiring 971 valid signatures for the November 2026 ballot was circulating as of 2026-07-18 ([reference], The Blade via thecooldown.com). AT THE TIME OF THIS PULL THE WINDOW WAS STILL OPEN — the outcome is [open], not captured. The eight parcels in this file that fall inside that rezoning are flagged rezoning_contestable_2026_07_07.

THE RECORD SHOWS EIGHT OF THE THIRTEEN REZONED PARCELS, AND THE GAP IS THE LAYER'S VINTAGE. The trustees rezoned 13 parcels / 31.82 ac; this snapshot shows 8 parcels / 21.37 ac in Liames' name (3 on Dixie Hwy, 3 on Mercer Rd, 2 on Middleton Pike). The press reports all thirteen as already owned by Meta with the houses and a strip of motel rooms already razed ([reference], BG Independent News 2026-06-03 / 2026-07-08). The missing 5 parcels / 10.45 ac are not identifiable here: max(Sale_Date) over the whole 73,839-row layer is 2025-07-25, so it cannot show a conveyance after that. [open] — the rezoning application's parcel schedule at the county planning commission is the instrument that would close it.

THREE ROWS ARE NOT PART OF THE HOLDING — READ `parcel_role` BEFORE QUOTING AN ACREAGE. parcel_role='rezoning_pending' is 611190000006000, 64.55 ac still deeded to A. SCHALLER LIMITED PARTNERSHIP since 1999-12-23, abutting the campus (0.0 m). The Wood County Planning Commission recommended rezoning 39.265 ac of it from A-1 to M-1 by 6-2 on 2026-07-07, for construction parking, with Liames LLC in contract to purchase and township action still pending ([verified] Sentinel-Tribune 2026-07-07 / BG Independent News 2026-07-06). THE APPLICATION IS FOR PART OF THE PARCEL, NOT ALL OF IT. The county serves the parcel as TWO disjoint rows (0.000 ac of overlap) of 39.621 ac and 25.294 ac, unioned here to 64.915 ac planar against 64.55 ac deeded; the mapped A-1 polygon covers 61.03% of the parcel, which is exactly the 39.621-ac EASTERN part — and the press places the application 'north of Ohio 582 on the east side of Ohio 25'. That the 39.265-ac application is that eastern part is [inference], not identity: the rezoning's own legal description is the instrument and is not in the corpus.

parcel_role='apollo_permit_situs' is 611200000011000, 79.07 ac at 11902 Middleton Pike, the address on the Apollo Power Generation Facility's Ohio EPA air permit — still deeded to JJJ FAMILY PROPERTIES LLC (20022 Mercer Rd, Bowling Green) since 2008-12-22. WILL-POWER OH, LLC OWNS NO LAND IN WOOD COUNTY at this snapshot: a countywide owner scan on '%WILL-POWER%' returns zero rows, so the 350 MW behind-the-meter plant sits on land it does not own. This parcel is NOT the project boundary — the OPSB staff report's ~146.84-acre project area reconciles to no parcel or contiguous parcel group in this layer (the report itself gives 146.84 / 163 / 165.11 ac for three different boundaries), so the plant's footprint stays [open]. The parcel does abut the campus (0.0 m) and reads 100% M-1.

parcel_role='oppidan_colo' is 511210000002003, 11.80 ac deeded to CLOP BOWLING GREEN OH LLC on 2025-02-03 for $1,105,000 — the Oppidan Investment Company colo in the Woodbridge Business Park, IN THE CITY of Bowling Green and 7,771 m (4.83 mi) from the nearest campus boundary. The owner's mailing address, 400 Water St Suite 200, Excelsior MN 55331, is Oppidan's own headquarters, which is what identifies the SPE. This upgrades the register's '~12 ac' [reference] to 11.80 ac deeded [verified]. Its situs reads 2371 Woodstream in this snapshot; the building's address is 2501 Woodstream Dr. It is a SEPARATE facility with a separate developer and end user — never fold its acreage or load into the Meta campus.

Right-county guard: WOOD County OHIO (FIPS 39173), tax districts J34 and J36 (Middleton Twp) and B07 (City of Bowling Green). Bowling Green KENTUCKY (Warren County) is this site's standing search trap. The neighbouring landowners include a LIMES family (Dale Limes LLC, Limes Real Estate Holdings LLC, Limes Galen E) whose name differs from LIAMES by one letter — check the spelling before reading a Devils Hole Rd parcel as part of the assembly.
